thread:
emma-partners: quick sync 1: we keep getting messy handoffs between marketplace leads, HW partner triage, and SI engagement. propose a simple plumbing: intake_tag (marketplace/hw/si), account_tier (smb/mid/enterprise), and a single `claim_window` determined by tier. sketch below.

rafael: sounds great. can we also include `canonical_domain` in the intake so account mapping is automated? biggest source of duplicates.

gina-solutions: +1. also recommend a short AE guidance field `ae_quick_read` with 1 line: owner + must-have context (eg: needs-private-deploy). helps SIs decide whether to claim.

emma-partners: plumbing proposal: 1) marketplace -> intake service. 2) if lead_source==marketplace-hw route to hw-queue for 48h triage; hw can tag `requires_si`. 3) claim windows: SMB=24h, MID=48h, ENT=72h. 4) enforce ownership precedence AE > field-advocate > SI. 5) conflict timeout: tier-based (align windows) then escalate to #partner-ops.

ops-bot: [bot] New intake recorded: partner=IntegratorBeta account=StellarCo lead_source=marketplace-hw account_tier=mid canonical_domain=stellar.co

rafael: for account mapping rules: match by canonical_domain, else by tax_id/parent_account, else manual triage. write mapping history to a log field `mapping_audit`.

gina-solutions: joint announcements: add `announce_intent` boolean on intake. if true -> require partner PR approval + customer opt-in + launch asset checklist (1-pager, co-demo recording). legal and marketing gets auto-cc.

security: note: if deploy_mode==private then auto-cc security and add `data_flow` checkbox. that must be completed before SI scheduling.

hw-partner-bot: [bot] hw-triage created for StellarCo. SLA 48h.

emma-partners: ops items: - add intake fields: canonical_domain, account_tier, deploy_mode, ae_quick_read, announce_intent - routing rule: marketplace-hw -> hw-queue first - implement tiered claim windows - escalate path to #partner-ops after timeout. pilot for 2 weeks starting next Mon.

rafael: can we also auto-generate an AE one-liner slide (1 slide) explaining how to read claim tags and who to ping? tiny enablement.

gina-solutions: i'll draft the one-liner and a sample webhook payload to include in Confluence. sample payload as single-line JSON: {"source":"marketplace","partner":"IntegratorBeta","account":"StellarCo","canonical_domain":"stellar.co","account_tier":"mid","deploy_mode":"hosted","announce_intent":false}

emma-partners: perfect. when i post the Confluence doc tomorrow pls react with :eyes: so we can flip the pilot. thanks all.
